name: NIGHT/SHADE: You're the Drug
source:
Why would a person take someone's life? To protect? For love? When you are backed into a corner and have no way out, what will you do then?

Sobena, 2040, the cultural fusion city of neon lights and echoes of discreet underground clubs. Sasha, a 27 year old drug dealer, has found himself in an aimless cycle of indulgences that he has no intention of addressing. He has become comfortable with his place in this city, unaware of the shifting ground beneath his feet.

When he and his best friend, Mishka, are abruptly caught in the middle of a power struggle between two crime syndicates, Sasha is forced to confront himself and his feelings in order to save those most important to him. The two of them must overcome their immense aversion to change or risk losing everything.

[From [url=https://nightshadevn.com/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
一個人為何會奪走他人的生命？為了保護誰？為了愛？當你被逼入絕境、無路可逃時，又會怎麼做？

2040年，索貝納是一座文化交融的城市，霓虹閃爍，隱秘的地下俱樂部中迴響著聲浪。27歲的毒販薩沙，陷入毫無目標、反覆縱慾的生活，卻絲毫不打算改變。他安於自己在城中的位置，完全沒有察覺腳下的局勢正在變化。

當他與最好的朋友米什卡突然被捲入兩個犯罪集團的權力鬥爭中時，為了拯救最重要的人，薩沙不得不直面自己與內心的感情。兩人必須克服對改變的強烈抗拒，否則便可能失去一切。
